messages:
lee: quick heads-up: onboarding harbor-q4-int8 onto tools.invoke is showing a small but persistent class of parse failures (~3.7%) tied to explanatory inline comments and escaped quotes in arrays

lee: failing snippet we pulled from sampler:
```
context: model unsure
{"action": "batch_update", "items": [
  {"id": 1, "note": "Needs \"urgent\" review"},
  {"id": 2, "note": "ok"}
]
}

extra: trailing commentary
```

anya: aha, escaped quotes inside a quoted string plus a stray `extra: trailing commentary` line. json loads blow up on that mid-array.

tom: suggest lightweight two-stage approach: 1) prefilter: drop leading/trailing non-json lines until first `{` and last `}` heuristics match; 2) tolerant sanitize: unescape doubled-escaped quotes and remove dangling commas; 3) strict-validate against schema; 4) if repair passes schema -> mark `repair.autoclean=true` else emit `__raw` wrapper. keep retry budget to 1.

frank: nit: we must be conservative with autoclean for canaries. If keys change shape (extra/missing keys) mark `repair.suspect=true` and route to manual review. Also add `repair.delta` count (keys added/removed).

infra-bot: canary-start harbor-q4-int8 job=77101. logs: https://ci/canary/77101. sampler=active.

lee: small python prototype I used to unescape broken inner quotes before parse:
```python
s=open('sample.txt').read()
# trim non-json prefix/suffix
start=s.find('{')
end=s.rfind('}')
jm=s[start:end+1]
# heuristic: replace \"\"\" (escaped-quote sequences) with \"
jm=jm.replace('\\\"\\\"\\\"', '\\"')
import json
try:
  o=json.loads(jm)
  print('ok')
except Exception as e:
  print('fail', e)
```

anya: two edgecases: 1) escaped sequences that are intentional, 2) arrays split across stream boundaries (model sent partial second item). For case 2 we should prefer a single retry against `harbor-q4-int8-soft` (higher-precision) with jitter instead of overzealous fixes.

tom: agree. propose policy: repair-only pipeline runs first; if repair fails -> one soft-variant retry -> if still fails, wrap as `__raw`. Track metrics: `parse.fail`, `repair.attempt`, `repair.success`, `retry.attempt`, `retry.variant`, `downstream.contract_violation`.

frank: add telemetry `repair.method` values: ["prefilter","unescape","trailing-commas","append-brace"] and `repair.confidence` float string between 0.0-1.0. Also make sure Dedicated orgs must opt-in for autoclean.

anya: i'll add unit tests for: escaped-quotes-in-array, split-array-item, intentional-escaped-sequence, and truncated-suffix. will also make a small fuzz corpus simulating quant artifacts (mid-token splits, commentary prefixes).

lee: plan: enable repair pipeline only on canary for 12h, soft-retry enabled, collect telemetry and human review samples where `repair.suspect=true`. rollback if downstream contract errors > 0.05% in 1h.

infra-bot: canary job 77101 > health ok. sampler throughput steady.

tom: i'll implement repair flags in config: `repair:{enabled:true, methods:["prefilter","unescape"], suspect_threshold:0.3}` and `retry:{attempts:1, variant:"harbor-q4-int8-soft", backoff_ms:250}`.

frank: remember to add `repair.delta` and `repair.suspect` to logs and to index them in tracing so we can slice by customer/route.

anya: on it. i'll open PR for tests + harness and link here. :white_check_mark:

lee: great, thanks. reconvene after 12h AB to decide wider rollout. :eyes:
